title: Complex Four-Index Unified Field Theory: SU (1, 1) × SU (1, 2) × SU (1, 3) Kähler Geometry, Four-Sector Normalization, Dark Matter, and Quantum Gravity
summary: his paper formulates a purely complex unified field theory on a four-dimensional pseudo-Kähler manifold (M, J, gαβ̄ , ω) of signature (1, 3) governed by the non-compact gauge andspacetime symmetry SU (1, 1) × SU (1, 2) × SU (1, 3). Gravitation and matter are unifiedwithin the complex four-index field equation Gαβ̄γ δ̄ = κTαβ̄γ δ̄ whose trace-free sector directlycouples the Bochner curvature tensor to the complex vacuum energy-momentum tensor(Bαβ̄γ δ̄ = κT̂αβ̄γ δ̄ ). Global regularity and normalizability are established through the four-sector orientation symmetry Ng ∈ Z4 = {0, 1, 2, 3}…
